title: EPC 的 云储存
description: 该模组添加了云存储，让你可以随时随地按Y键打开箱子存储物品 | This mod adds cloud storage, allowing you to press the Y button to open a chest and store items anytime, anywhere.
body:
# 简体中文：

此模组为游戏添加了一个云容器，你可以随时按“Y”键打开它，它的容量为大箱子容量（54格），不过在默认情况下有5页可用。你也可以去手动设置它的可用页数，只需要在 **config\epc-cloud-box** 中将 **{"maxPages": 5}** 的数字5更改为你想要设置的最大页数。

虽然此模组支持除了1.21.1以外的版本，但仍建议只下载1.21.1的版本，因为其他版本非主动适配，而是Fabric代码兼容

---

# English

This mod adds a cloud container to the game. You can open it at any time by pressing the “Y” key. Its capacity is equal to that of a large chest (54 slots), but by default, it has 5 pages available. You can also manually set the number of available pages by changing the number 5 in **{“maxPages”: 5}** to your desired maximum number of pages in the **config\epc-cloud-box** file.

Although this mod supports versions other than 1.21.1, it is still recommended that you download only the 1.21.1 version, as compatibility with other versions is not actively maintained but is based on Fabric code compatibility.
